faq.question: What is the maximum file size I can upload?
faq.canonicalAnswer: The maximum upload size is 500 MB per file on all plans.

passages.text: Files larger than 100 MB will be rejected by the uploader.
You can upload files up to 500 MB regardless of your subscription tier.
Uploaded files are automatically scanned for viruses before processing.
